_docs: Drop this file in your course folder. Only include keys you want to CHANGE from the defaults.
_language_comment: Language for ALL challenge lessons in this course. 'html', 'css', 'javascript' run in-browser. Everything else routes through Wandbox (https://wandbox.org). Individual challenge.json files can override with their own 'language' field.
_language_options: html | css | javascript | c | cpp | python | rust | go | java | kotlin | swift | ruby | lua | perl | php | bash | haskell | erlang | ocaml | scala | nim | crystal | d | typescript | r | pascal | coffeescript

features._comment: All features default to true except where noted. Only add a key to change it.
features._theorySandbox: Sandbox + step-through tracer on theory lessons. Set false to hide it entirely.
features._consoleOutput: Show a JS console pane instead of live preview (for JS-only courses).
